patch_description: The current greedy only considers the GPU's existing load ratio, not the resulting KVPR after placing the model, and does no refinement. Replace with best-fit greedy (choose GPU minimizing resulting KVPR) plus a local-search move phase that repeatedly tries to move models off the worst GPU whenever it lowers the global max KVPR. This mirrors the prior successful approach and should substantially reduce max KVPR while remaining simple and safe (with feasibility checks and reverts).
